title: Ovary
description: Part of an ovary taken up by one large antral follicle: a fluid-filled antrum lined by granulosa cells, with the theca and the ovarian stroma around it.
look_for: The antrum, filled with follicular fluid (which looks like a pale pink net)
Granulosa cells: a layer a few cells thick lining the antrum
The theca: spindle-shaped cells and small vessels around the granulosa
Ovarian stroma: densely packed spindle-shaped cells, with blood vessels

labels.text: Antrum of a large antral follicle (follicular fluid)
Theca (layers of spindle-shaped cells around the granulosa)

labels.find: a small artery in the stroma

source.name: GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression) project
source.pathology_note: 2 pieces, 10x4 mm; numerous ova and follicles in various stages of normal function
source.via: NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC), collection gtex
source.changes: A region of the slide was cut out and re-encoded as a WebP image pyramid; nothing else was changed.
